sloka: यदि शक्रो यदि यमो यदि पावकमारुतौ ।तानहं योधयिष्यामि कुबेरवरुणावपि ।। ६.६३.४३ ।।
transliteration: yadi śakro yadi yamo yadi pāvakamārutau ।tānahaṁ yodhayiṣyāmi kuberavaruṇāvapi ।। 6.63.43 ।।

translations.english: "I shall exterminate your enemies, however mighty they may be. I can contend with Indra or fire god or Yama or wind god, Kubera or even Varuna."
